subject: Workplace Skills
title: Deep Work vs Shallow Work
description: A quick win: understand Deep Work vs Shallow Work.

hook.text: Cal Newport coined deep work: cognitively demanding tasks done without distraction that produce real value.

buildup.text: Shallow work is email, Slack, status meetings. It feels productive but rarely moves the needle.

discovery.text: Deep work creates the output that earns promotions. Shallow work maintains the status quo at best.

twist.text: Most professionals spend 60% of their day on shallow tasks and wonder why important projects stall.

climax.text: Track where your hours go for one week. The ratio of deep to shallow will shock you into change.

punchline.text: Measure your deep hours. Then double them.

quiz.question: What defines deep work according to Cal Newport?
options: Working more than eight hours per day
Cognitively demanding tasks done without distraction
